_comment: Base items. Weapon and ore-bar items are generated from weapons.json x ores.json by the loader. food/water = need restored when consumed.

ration.name: Travel Ration
ration.desc: Hard bread, cheese and dried meat. The staple of the road.

fish.name: Fish
fish.desc: Fresh catch. Spoils if you dawdle.

grain.name: Grain Sack
grain.desc: Milled into bread or fed to livestock.

water.name: Water Flask
water.desc: Clean water. Refill at wells, springs and streams.

ale.name: Ale
ale.desc: Not as hydrating as water, but more popular.

herbal_salve.name: Herbal Salve
herbal_salve.desc: A pungent salve that knits wounds.

mirelight_herb.name: Mirelight Herb
mirelight_herb.desc: A softly glowing swamp herb prized by mages and apothecaries.

fiber.name: Plant Fiber
fiber.desc: Twisted into rope, cloth and bowstrings.

thornwood.name: Thornwood
thornwood.desc: Dense, springy eastern wood. Excellent for bows and hafts.

scrap.name: Scrap Metal
scrap.desc: Salvage. Melts down into Rustite bars.

relic_shard.name: Relic Shard
relic_shard.desc: A fragment of the vanished builders' work. Mages pay well.

trinket.name: Old Trinket
trinket.desc: A locket, a ring, a carved token — someone's lost keepsake.

mana_crystal.name: Mana Crystal
mana_crystal.desc: Crystallised mana. Restores mana or fuels spell scribing.

mana_draught.name: Mana Draught
mana_draught.desc: Bitter blue tonic that restores mana.

powder_shot.name: Powder & Shot
powder_shot.desc: A paper cartridge of blackpowder and pellets.

bedroll.name: Bedroll
bedroll.desc: Rest in the wild without exposure penalties.

nails.name: Nails
nails.desc: Rustite nails. Every building needs them.

arcane_dust.name: Arcane Dust
arcane_dust.desc: Ground mana crystal. A base for magical crafting.

enchanted_ink.name: Enchanted Ink
enchanted_ink.desc: Glowing ink prized by scribes and enchanters. Spells no longer need it to be inscribed, but alchemists and mage shops pay well for it.

voidglass_manual.name: Voidglass Smithing Notes
voidglass_manual.desc: A smith's private notes on working Voidglass. Reading them teaches the craft.

spire_core.name: Spire Core
spire_core.desc: A humming heart of the vanished builders' tower. The Ashen Circle would give anything for it.

seed_grain.name: Grain Seed
seed_grain.desc: Plant it in a farm plot.

seed_herb.name: Herb Cuttings
seed_herb.desc: Plant them in a farm plot.

leather_jerkin.name: Leather Jerkin
leather_jerkin.desc: Stitched hide armor. Light and quiet.

starfall_blade.name: Starfall Blade
starfall_blade.desc: A sword of star-metal from the Shattered Spire. It hums before it strikes.

skyglass_bow.name: Skyglass Bow
skyglass_bow.desc: A crystal bow grown in Starfall Basin. Arrows leave trails of light.

emberheart_hammer.name: Emberheart Hammer
emberheart_hammer.desc: Forged in the Ashfall vents by no living smith. Still warm.
